basic_details.job_title: JNCASR Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru, an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, has one temporary Research Associate position in its Engineering Mechanics Unit under the guidance of Prof. Santosh Ansumali. The pay is Rs.58000/- per month plus 30% HRA. Candidates need a theoretical/computational PhD in soft matter physics, fluid mechanics or solid mechanics and must be no older than the maximum age of 35 years. Applications go by email, latest by 15 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are made by email only. These are the steps the notice gives:
Get the application form from the website and fill it in completely.
Scan the duly filled-in application form.

Engineering Mechanics Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR
content_sections.text: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research is located at Jakkur, Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka. The notice describes it as an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an institution Deemed-to-be-University. The Research Associate will work in the Engineering Mechanics Unit under Prof. Santosh Ansumali.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Educational Qualification: Theoretical/Computational PhD in either of (a) soft matter physics, (b) fluid mechanics, (c) solid mechanics. Required Skillset: Good command of C/C++ GPU computing Demonstrated capability of writing own PDE solver(s) Age Limit: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: JNCASR Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the project the Research Associate will support as follows: "We aim to leverage large-scale simulations using tools like finite differences and PINNs to study systems with fluid-solid coupling with biological applications, e.g., flow of RBCs." The work therefore involves large-scale simulations of fluid-solid coupled systems with biological applications. This is why the required skillset asks for C/C++, GPU computing and experience in writing one's own PDE solvers.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Research Associate
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email only. These are the steps the notice gives: Get the application form from the website and fill it in completely. Scan the duly filled-in application form. Scan the original testimonials supporting your educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Prepare a brief resume. Email the form, the testimonials and the resume to Prof. Santosh Ansumali, Engineering Mechanics Unit, JNCASR, at [email protected] , with a copy to the Engineering Mechanics Unit office email given in the notice. Send the email latest by 15 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the instructions to candidates, the selected candidate list will be invited for a technical discussion and personal interaction. The notice does not mention the date or the mode of this interaction.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JNCASR Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate position under Advt. No. EMU/024, in the Engineering Mechanics Unit of JNCASR, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by email latest by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a theoretical/computational PhD in either of (a) soft matter physics, (b) fluid mechanics or (c) solid mechanics. The required skillset is good command of C/C++, GPU computing and a demonstrated capability of writing their own PDE solver(s).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JNCASR Research Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.58000/- per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.58000 remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the remuneration as Rs.58000/- pm plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email a scanned copy of the filled-in application form from the website, scanned original testimonials and a brief resume to [email protected], with a copy to the Engineering Mechanics Unit office email, by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate list will be invited for a technical discussion and personal interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JNCASR Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes it as a temporary position of Research Associate under the guidance of Prof. Santosh Ansumali.
